description: Ego (15 m/s) behind a car in the same lane (100 m ahead, 10 m/s). When TTC < 12.29 s ego slows to 10 m/s.

clauses: TimeToCollisionCondition (class reference: distance / relative speed, no acceleration)
6.3.4 Vehicle coordinate system (reference point; BoundingBox.Center offset)
oracle.derivation: TTC = distance / relative speed, no acceleration; freespace: bounding-box gap (D-07): (100-5t-4.8)/5. < 12.29 first at t=6.76 (6.74 gives 12.30). Cubic 15->10 over [6.76, 9.76].

expect.esminiNote: esmini 3.6.0 evaluates TimeToCollisionCondition as true on its first check at t=0 (true TTC is 19 s); a level (edge none) condition exposes it, a rising edge used to mask it
